summary: Full backend + frontend test pass for RAWDJA / The Needle Drop. 9/9 pytest backend tests passed (root, stats, issuance + hash chaining, verify valid/invalid, founder verify, ledger integrity, stats==integrity total). 18/18 Playwright UI checks passed (home hero, 6 module cards, chapter content, bonus Goblin Mode gallery, teacher's guide sections, downloads, both printable editions with Print button, certificate issue flow renders card with serial+hash, no Founder badge for seq>=2, verify Authentic for founder serial, Not verified for fake serial). Chapter prev/next nav walks all 6 chapters and last chapter exposes a 'Get Certified' link to /certificate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: certificate issuance is not transactional. A race between two concurrent POST /certificates calls can read the same `last` and produce two certs with the same seq/prev_hash, breaking the chain. Consider a unique index on `seq` and retry-on-duplicate, or a counters collection with $inc, or a Mongo transaction.
server.py: GENESIS_HASH is not a valid SHA-256 hex string (it is a label). That is fine semantically, but document it so future auditors do not flag it as 'corrupt prev_hash' on cert #1.
server.py: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers.
server.py: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject that combo. Tighten allow_origins for prod or set allow_credentials=False.
Certificate.jsx: hash is rendered with break-all but no copy-to-clipboard affordance; minor UX improvement for verifiability.
seed_data_creation: Issued a handful of TEST_-prefixed certificates (TEST_Chainer One/Two, TEST_VerifyMe, TEST_LedgerCheck, TEST_UI Runner) during the test run. They are persisted in MongoDB and counted in /api/stats. Not cleaned up because the ledger is append-only by design (deleting them would break the chain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Founder cert RAWDJA-2026-00001-9MD5E4 (seq=1, name 'Xophur') is verified valid. After this run, the ledger total moved up by ~5 due to TEST_ certs. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is idempotent — safe to re-run; it always issues fresh certs and chains/verifies against them. UI testid coverage is complete (chapter-card-*, tab-issue, tab-verify, certificate-name-input, issue-certificate-btn, verify-serial-input, verify-certificate-btn, certificate-card, verify-result, print-button, download-student, download-teacher).
